request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: If the IGEA-PRIM 5t overhead travelling crane at position 13 were used under regular conditions, i.e. outside the construction, steel, port and extractive sectors, how often would it have to be verified?

response.text: {"kind": "duration", "value": "P3Y", "text": "Assuming the crane is a fixed installation, a regular-use, fixed overhead crane built in 2017 (less than 10 years old) must be verified every three years under Allegato VII, D.Lgs. 81/08, row 18. The files do not expressly classify overhead travelling cranes as fixed or mobile, so this is an inference; if it were treated as mobile, the rule would be biennial (row 13). The crane reaches 10 years in 2027, after which the fixed-crane rule in row 17 gives biennial checks.", "sources": [{"file": "DLGSALLVII.md", "place": "Allegato VII, riga 18", "quote": "Apparecchi di sollevamento materiali con portata superiore a 200 Kg. non azionati a mano, di tipo fisso, con modalità di utilizzo regolare e anno di fabbricazione non antecedente 10 anni | Verifiche triennali"}, {"file": "DLGSALLVII.md", "place": "Allegato VII, riga 13", "quote": "Apparecchi di sollevamento materiali con portata superiore a 200 Kg. non azionati a mano, di tipo mobile o trasferibile, con modalità di utilizzo regolare e anno di fabbricazione non antecedente 10 anni | Verifica biennale"}, {"file": "igea-equipment.md", "place": "p. 6 (Allegato A, Tabella A2, posizione 13)", "quote": "GRU A PONTE 2017- 13 IGEA -PRIM 5t 5000 2017 gen-17 SCORREVOLE 200086/CA"}]}
